checks.rule: Timestamped DTM archive contains surveys carried out since 1998
DTM removes surface objects using algorithms and manual editing
Timestamped rasters are GeoTIFF in 5km zip tiles
Vertical datum is Ordnance Survey Newlyn
Raster alignment is OS Grid / EPSG:27700
Survey-era transformation must be retained because transformation varies by survey time period
DSM includes vehicles buildings vegetation and terrain and must not substitute for DTM terrain height
Coverage metadata can identify date resolution transformation and geoidal model for a location
Timestamped survey date must be retained with any parcel-level elevation sample
